{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -c 8

# Note: PBS -q directive (gLiotq) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Queue selection not preserved. Job may run on different queue/priority.
# Note: PBS -l mem directive (64G) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Memory limits not enforced. Job may be killed if exceeding node memory.
# Note: PBS ngpus=1 does not translate to Flux batch script directives.
# You may need to use 'flux mini submit -g 1' or '--gpus-per-node=1' at submission time.
# Performance consideration: GPU allocation not specified in batch script. Job may not have access to GPUs.
# Note: PBS -v directive (DOCKER_IMAGE environment variable) can be set directly in the script.
# Note: PBS -k doe (keep output/error files) and -j oe (join output/error) are handled differently in Flux.
# Flux combines stdout and stderr by default unless separate --error is specified.

export DOCKER_IMAGE=imc.tut.ac.jp/transformers-pytorch-cuda118:4.31.0

echo "a"

cd ${FLUX_JOB_SUBMIT_DIR}

TORCH_HOME=`pwd`/.cache/torch
TRANSFORMERS_CACHE=`pwd`/.cache/transformers
HF_HOME=`pwd`/.cache/huggingface
export TORCH_HOME TRANSFORMERS_CACHE HF_HOME
export TORCH_USE_CUDA_DSA=1

poetry run accelerate launch --mixed_precision=bf16 src/train_emo_polarity_fine.py \
    --model_name rinna/japanese-gpt-neox-3.6b \
    --batch_size 32 --epochs 2 --learning_rate 1e-5 \
    --output_dir "/work/n213304/learn/anime_retweet_2/work_emo_analyze/llm-lora-classification/outputs/rinna__japanese-gpt-neox-3.6b"
"
}
